title: SCA Minhag of the Week 154: "Bar Missvah Boy's Aliya at the Sefer Torah"

chapters.title: Introduction to the Bar Missvah Boy's Alyah
chapters.about: Introduction to bar mitzvah alyah, brachah, and weekday versus Shabbat practices.

chapters.title: Halakha of a Katan and Past Practices on Shabbat
chapters.about: Halakha of a katan, community practices in the 40s and 50s, and extra alyot.

chapters.title: Community Growth and Changes on Shabbat and Weekdays
chapters.about: Shifting readings to the beginning of the parashah and weekday practices.

chapters.title: Developments in the 1960s and 1970s
chapters.about: Common practice by the 1960s, the time of Haham Latub Abadi, and later persistence.

chapters.title: Current Practice in Community Synagogues
chapters.about: Current practice across Halabi, Shami, Egyptian, and Lebanese synagogues.

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the practice regarding the bar mitzvah boy's alyah at the sefer torah on weekdays and on Shabbat. He explains the past practices in the community, changes over time, and the opinions and rulings found in the halakha concerning a katan.
questions: What is the common practice for a bar mitzvah boy's alyah on Shabbat and weekdays?
Did the community always give the bar mitzvah boy an alyah at the beginning of the parashah on Shabbat?
How was the practice handled on Mondays and Thursdays in the past compared to later years?
What role did Haham Latub Abadi's time period play in solidifying the practice?
